facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44, published in the Gazette on 13 June 2023 (the document's published date; no commencement date is given in the captured text), contains Part V on transborder data flow: section 31 on transfer of personal data to a state with adequate data protection and section 32 on transfer to a state without adequate protection.
